# MetroFuse 10.0 Beta 8

- New MetroFuse logo and nine icon themes.
- The startup guide shows where to import plugins, sign in, and order audio sources.
- Galaxy and Galaxy Blur return as player backgrounds.
- Playback can try more than one YouTube Music match after a source fails. Android can recover audio focus when you unlock during a playback interruption.
- Direct HTTPS media streaming now works across any public domain instead of restricting playback to YouTube hosts, fixing third-party lossless and audio plugins.

Install the signed Android APK over your current beta. On Windows, extract the x64 ZIP and run the launcher.
